body.p: Claims 1-8 are pending, with claim 1 being independent. Claims 1-8 stand rejected. Claims 1, 4 and 6 stand objected. Claims 1, 4, and 6 are amended herein. Support for all amendments are provided in the specification as originally filed, at least at paragraphs 0006, 0012, 0014, 0024, and 0056-0059. No new subject matter has been added.
The Title of the specification is objected as allegedly not descriptive. The Applicant herein amends the title as suggested in the Office Action.
Claim 1 stands objected to because the abbreviation of MEG and MCG must be

introduced in the claims as expanded prior to relying up on the abbreviated form regardless whether the term is introduced in the instant specification. Claim 1 is further objected because of lack of antecedent basis for the recited limitation "the same location.". Claim 1 is further objected to because of lack of antecedent basis for the recited limitation "the part of the patient." Claim 4 is objected to because of lack of antecedent basis for the recited limitation "the shape of a pellet.." Claim 6 is objected to because of lack of antecedent basis for the recited limitation "the position." Claims 1, 4, and 6 are amended herein to overcome the objections.

Claims 1-8 stand rejected under 35 U.S.C. § 112(b), second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter. Applicant herein amends Claims 1 and 6 to: (a) include the definition of the terms "MEG" and "MCG", and (b) to specify (MEG) or (MCG). Claim 6 is further amended to overcome the rejection over the previously recited term "simple matching." All pending claims are therefore believed to be patentable.

Applicant thanks the Examiner for the indication that Claims 1 and 6 would be allowable if rewritten or amended to overcome the rejection(s) under 35 U.S.C. 112(b) or 35 U.S.C. 112 (pre-AIA), 2nd paragraph, set forth in the Office action.

Applicant respectfully submits that the present application is in condition for allowance. Reconsideration of the application and an early Notice of Allowance are respectfully requested. In the event that the Examiner cannot allow the application for any reason, the Examiner is encouraged to contact Applicant's representative.
